title: Kiritani Haruka — Pouring My Heart In〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, over here!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Airi! Minori!
Sorry, the train arrived a little late...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're fine, you're right on time. We just got here a second ago ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Today, we're gonna whip up something that's nutritious, delicious and washes away any fatigue Shizuku's feeling!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shizuku's been practicing really late basically every day to make sure that her commercial turns out well...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is all I can really do for her right now, but I hope it helps.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we head over to the supermarket? We can decide what we're gonna make while we walk.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have a few candidates, but we still haven't been able to pick a winner.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm... Is something hearty the answer?
She's been working a lot on her physique, so I have to think that she's worked up a huge appetite.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, she's going to need something nutritious to recharge. Apparently, if you exercise on low energy reserves, your body begins breaking down muscle for fuel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But something light is also an option, right?
We gave her something meat-based just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: True... Then, what if we went with several light options, which will allow her to freely adjust her portions?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, fatigue makes you more susceptible to feeling under the weather, so we'll need to be sure to strike a good nutritional balance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right... It does become easier to catch a cold when your immune system is in a weakened state!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we're gonna make something that's both light and nutritious...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, how about we use veggies packed with beta-carotene? They're also usually loaded with vitamins.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Chicken breast is also a must.
It's a nice, low-fat source of protein with the skin removed. Not only does it help you recover quickly, it's also great for your physique.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, a low-calorie dish that's also really good for you is just what we're looking for this time around!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Exactly.
Anyway, what else can we do...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh, I know! What if we included some of Shizuku's favorite foods as a way to help put her mind at ease?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Like... Tofu skin or udon!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Udon?! That's a full dish by itself...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But I like that idea.
Not only should eating her favorite foods have a calming effect, they might also help her focus better during practices.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Actually, question.
Is there anything Shizuku really dislikes other than spicy foods?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As far as I know, not really.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Phew...
We came up with a ton of ideas!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Veggies high in beta-carotene, chicken breast, tofu skin, cabbage, olive oil... And vinegar, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but it might be harder to pick a dish now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... If only there were a way for us to cram all these things into a tidy package...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That'd be far too good to be true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A tidy package...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There might actually be a way.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We could use all of the things we just listed to make tortilla wraps.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tortilla wraps?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Tortillas? As in the kind you use to make tacos and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but I was thinking we could use corn instead of flour tortillas, since they're apparently full of minerals and fiber.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, it'd make things pretty easy for her, since all she'd have to do is put on whatever she likes and wrap it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right... That'd give her a lot more freedom, and we'd be able to include all the ingredients we just listed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just happened to come across it yesterday while searching for things we could make.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I saw it on this site...
This person made them look nice by wrapping them in fancy paper.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, these look like little bouquets.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, what if we got some paper with a design that Shizuku would really like?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, we have a huge list of ingredients, so it should be fun to try different combinations!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Both ideas sound good. So, why don't we spend today making Shizuku some wraps that we think she'd really like?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!
